target_customer: Teen and young adult consumers who read and play romance and fanfiction style interactive stories
problem: Fanfiction readers want to be the protagonist of stories that react to them, and existing text chat or reading apps do not do both.
business_model: Freemium consumer app with Y/n+ weekly and monthly subscriptions
product_category: Interactive story and AI character app

founders.name: Gabriel Birnbaum
prior_employers: Substack (first product designer, per YC bio)
previous_startups: Can of Soup (AI photo sharing app, outcome not stated)
founders.background_notes: Researched plasma physics per YC bio.

founders.name: Eric Meier
education: Karlsruhe Institute of Technology, computer science

technical_complexity.rationale: Consumer app on top of third party LLMs plus a story editor and feed; mostly product and content work, with scaling cost as the hard part.

defensibility.rationale: A library of community stories and fans gives some content network effects, but characters and fanfiction chat are easy to copy and the engine is a rented model.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Character chat apps and story platforms occupied the space; Y/n was still active in 2026 with its own app and a c.ai chat import tool per its website.

market_need_then: Reader insert Y/N fiction was a large youth fanfiction genre on Wattpad and Tumblr per Fanlore and Know Your Meme, indicating existing demand for the format.

branding.name_origin: Y/N is the fanfiction placeholder for the reader's name (short for Your Name), so the app name signals the play as yourself premise.
branding.domain_note: Domain yn.app; the .com is not used. Legal entity shown as Emittance Inc.

identity.visual_style: Playful, romance and fandom oriented story art on a feed
identity.voice_and_tone: Upbeat and playful tagline Play your story

branding.community_and_virality: Y/N is a long running fan culture term and the site has fandom categories; no brand press found.

brand_strength.rationale: The name taps an existing youth fandom meme, which helps instant comprehension, but it is also hard to search and shared with a slang term.

outcome_analysis: Y/n is active in 2026 as a consumer interactive story app on iOS with paid subscriptions, per its App Store listing and website. The company claims 100K plus teen users, which is unverified. A reported $14M raise is only in one Spanish language snippet and could not be confirmed. The stage of traction is therefore unclear and no failure or exit has been reported.
notes: Reported seed of about $14M with Eight Capital (Spanish report on ecosistemastartup.com, page returned 403, and a Standout profile) is unverified and not recorded as a round. YC page lists founded 2025 while batch is Summer 2023; the app launched in 2025 per a profile, so founded_year is left null. No dated 2023 competitor found; roundups are 2025 and 2026.
